text: This 6-arcmin patch of sky has been imaged 42 times over a year, covering wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.96 microns. Watch the two faint solar-system bodies, 416526 (2003 YK171) and 476778 (2008 UF128), as they drift across the frame.
